create_pipeline_inpaint: create a StableDiffusionControlNetInpaintPipeline for image inpainting with ControlNet conditioning
run_inpaint_generation: run the pipeline to inpaint an image given a prompt, source image, mask, and ControlNet conditioning image
prepare_mask_image: prepare a mask image tensor by binarizing values below and above 0.5 threshold
prepare_controlnet_conditioning_image: prepare a ControlNet conditioning image resized to target dimensions with proper batching and dtype
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode text prompts into CLIP text embeddings with optional negative prompt for classifier-free guidance
